learning_outcomes.text: Know and confidently use subject-specific terminology.
Name the properties of sensors and actuators.
Can name the properties of a microcontroller.
Design a sampled-data control loop using z-transformation and know techniques for implementing controllers on a microcontroller.
Apply learned methods to similar problems in mechatronics.
Solve tasks also in a small group, and can communicate and explain technical content.
Independently and in a team delve into mechatronics topics and can competently discuss them.
Understand how their own learning style can be improved and how collaboration with others can be enhanced.

syllabus_topics: Basic structure of Mechatronics
Definition, characteristics and basic principles of Mechatronics
Sampled-data control
Approximate solution using difference quotients
z-Transformation
Consideration of the hold element
Tustin approximation and Euler difference equation
Construction of a sampled-data control loop
Microcontrollers
Architecture
Interfaces and A/D and D/A conversion
Implementation of sampled-data control in the microcontroller
Sensors
Classification and properties, signal forms, signal conditioning
Measurement chain, integrated and intelligent sensor technology
Measurement of quantities such as displacement, distance, velocity, acceleration, force, pressure, flow, temperature, light quantity
Actuators
Overview, classification, properties, areas of application
Electric motors: DC, synchronous, asynchronous motors, stepper motor
Application in control engineering examples

assessment_methods.method: Proof of attendance (pass/fail) for practical part
